notes.title: Galactic Glitch: Prologue IS FINALLY OUT!
notes.content:
Greetings Legioneers!

The wait is finally over! The free Prologue version of our physics-based Action Roguelike, Galactic Glitch, is out now! Download the game here and start blasting the universe to bits like never before!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/640160/Galactic_Glitch_Prologue/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32216392/f773bbe581402e46ff5157ab0d88bc68da157d89.png[/img]

What's in the Prologue? Let's break it down:
[list]
[*] Experience Two Full Levels: Navigate through unique enemies and environments, while testing your skills against a challenging final boss.
[*] Unleash Your Power in Multiple Challenge Modes: Put your abilities to the test in our varied challenge modes.
[*] Discover NG+ Modes: Want more of a challenge? We've added three game-altering NG+ modes that add new enemies and up the ante.
[*] Physics-Based Roguelike Action: Command an advanced space fighter and use the power of gravity to hurl asteroids, stop missiles, and turn the battlefield to your advantage.
[/list]
Remember, while Galactic Glitch: Prologue gives you a taste of our galaxy, the full meal is yet to come! Although the main title is expected to launch later this year, you can add Galactic Glitch: Infinity’s Edge to your wishlists on Steam right now.

For the latest news and updates, connect with us on our social channels:

Twitter: https://twitter.com/CrunchyLeafGame
Discord: https://discord.gg/6jPYbpZa2g

notes.title: Introducing Galactic Glitch: Prologue - Join the Playtest Now!
notes.content:
Greetings Legioneers! 🚀  It's been a while, but now we have some thrilling news for you!

We're soon launching "Galactic Glitch Prologue," a new FREE version of our upcoming game!

The game is an Action-Roguelike with physics-based combat. You'll be fighting in bubbles of glitched Spacetime, hurling asteroids, bouncing foes off of walls and destroying your enemies piece-by-piece on your path to break out of your galactic prison!


The Prologue version includes:
[list]
[*] Two full levels, each with unique enemies and environments
[*] Multiple NG+ modes, with new enemies, new combat setups, and other added challenging elements
[*] A hub area, where players can restock supplies and decide where to head out to next
[*] Three Challenge Modes, where players face waves of enemies in ever more difficult Arena-based 
[*] Tons of weapons and powers for you to experiment with and find your favorite builds!
[/list]

Just as with Crystal Clash and Rise of Legions before it, your input and feedback is invaluable to us! We're really looking forward to hearing what you have to say about all crazy weapons, powers, and enemies we've stuffed in there for you! 🙌

You can join the playtest by clicking the "Join Playtest" button right below the Wishlist/Follow section:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/640160/Galactic_Glitch_Prologue/

notes.title: Rise of Legions - Introducing: The Crystal Legion!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32216392/6ea76a04eed96333a306bdf4fd602b70b72b776e.png[/img]

Hey guys,

it’s been a little longer coming, but this week’s update is a [b]sweet [/b]one! 

We’ve been listening to [b]player feedback[/b], both in-game and out, and we’ve been hearing a lot of players asking for [b]more unit and spell variety[/b]. So we decided to pull the trigger, and bring you another big one...

[b]The Crystal Legion[/b], the Golem Army, is now a playable Legion! With their own [b]unique units[/b] and completely [b]new spells[/b], they are a force to be reckoned with! Especially their starter spells, which you can [b]unlock [/b]after just one additional game, pack quite a bit of punch.

The first is “[b]Echoes of the Future[/b]”, which allows you to [b]double your income[/b] for 20 seconds (!!). But you have to pay a steep price, which is 20 seconds of no income afterwards. So if you do decide to go for it, you better make those first 20 seconds count! The second starter spell, [b]Cataclysm[/b], is a real game changer. It’s a Divine spell, which you can only use once per match, and for good reason: When the fight has not gone your way and the enemy army is knocking at your Nexus’ door, no matter how huge that army is, [b]this spell will let you annihilate it[/b], completely destroying all their precious units, and allowing you to stage your comeback! Use this power wisely... :)

Check out the full list of units and spells below:

[h1]New Units[/h1]
[list][*] [b]Granite Scouts[/b] - These are front line fighters that will take the hurt for your initial push
[*] [b]Stone Weavers[/b] - Straight up DPS damage dealers, keep them well protected!
[*] [b]Crystal Enforcers[/b] - A strong siege unit, needs to be well protected to keep its shot charge going
[*] [b]Granite Vanguard[/b] - Mid-game Tanks, to strenghten your push and deal some AoE damage in the area in front of them
[*] [b]Crystal Chanter[/b] - Early game Support unit. Can strengthen other DPS units around it, so it works well in larger groups
[*] [b]Granite Bouncer[/b] - Stable defensive tank, with good AoE damage. It can’t move, so you’ll mainly be using it defensively *glaces suspiciously at Relocate*
[*] [b]Crystal Observer[/b] - A flying DPS unit that can take a few hits. Might get your opponents in trouble if they’re not well prepared
[*] [b]Granite Chieftain[/b] - Very strong tank, that can spawn additional Granite Scouts when it’s damaged
[*] [b]Crystal Crescendo[/b] - An unblindable late-game DPS monster. I keep having to think of Rays from the Void when I see this one...
[*] [b]Crystal Temple[/b] - A long range late-game damage dealer. Each hit does massive damage, and it shoots fairly fast too. You really don’t want to be on the wrong side of this one!
[*] [b]Granite Guardian[/b] - A massive monster of a unit. Too huge to make sense in any normal way. Deals huge splash damage and has a very thick skin (brick?). As if all that wasn’t enough, when it’s summoned, it also spawns a huge enemy-wave-destroying Asteroid (!!)
[/list]

[h1]New Spells[/h1]
[list][*] [b]Echoes of the Future[/b] - You can pull future income into the here and now. Very powerful, but needs to be used wisely
[*] [b]Cataclysm[/b] - A enemy-annihilating monster spell. When near your Nexus, it can destroy any enemy wave, no matter how large, but can only be played once per match!
[*] [b]Petrify[/b] - A spell that makes units completely incapacitated, but also heals them at the same time. You’ll need some skill to use this effectively!
[*] [b]Stone Circle[/b] - Create an area in which your units only take half damage from abilities and spells, while also giving your front-line units massively increased damage
[*] [b]Earthquake[/b] - A legendary and massive damage dealing spell. Creates an Earthquake that stuns, and will shatter your enemy’s lines with tons of damage
[/list]

We hope you like these new additions to the pool of cards! We’re very much looking forward to your feedback, so please let us know what you think!

You can keep up to date by following us on Twitter and Facebook:

https://twitter.com/Rise_Of_Legions
https://www.facebook.com/RiseOfLegions

Join us on the Discord to share your opinion, chat or just hangout!

http://riseoflegions.com/discord

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32216392/f71139bcb4177f9eda7d928dcac12b682ee2ffaf.png[/img]

Hey everybody,

another week, another sweet update! This time we’re adding the much-requested [b]Pings for 2v2 [/b]and lots of [b]balancing [/b]changes, that will help keep the meta fresh and the battles brutal!

In terms of [b]Pings[/b], there are 3 different varieties to choose from. The different types will help you coordinate with your partner for [b]attack [/b]and [b]defense[/b], or simply help you point out things of interest on the map. We’re very curious how you guys will use these, and to hear your feedback on them!

Next up are the balancing changes, of which there are quite a lot again. We’ve been trying to identify more underused units, like the [b]Frostgoyle[/b], [b]Oracle[/b], [b]Mulch Digger[/b], or [b]Marksman[/b], and gave them a nice little [b]buff[/b]. We’ve also identified some overused tactics, like the [b]turret+aimbot+relocate[/b] plays, which we balanced out a bit, to have less of an advantage, but still be usable as a tactical choice.

We're also balancing [b]2v2 [/b]further, to give players more of an [b]defender's advantage[/b] at their [b]towers[/b], and to give them a better chance to push an enemy wave back, even when it's reached a decent size.

Check out the full changelist below:

[h1]Features[/h1][list]
[*] Added a ping feature for all team modes to alert your allies with either a normal, attack and defend ping (better sounds for them are coming soon)
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]

[*] Fixed Mirror Slime to reflect status effects to units with Surefire
[*] Fixed Avengers to not reset attack when their health goe below or above the Inner Fire threshold
[/list]
[h1]Balancing[/h1] [list]

[*] Oracle increased health from 610 to 675

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32216392/790530dcd5cac859c625f445b41c10802da10328.png[/img]

The big day has come!

The full game is OUT NOW, with the entire [b]Blue Legion[/b], a mechanical army built around energy mechanics and instant teleportation, and of course the long-awaited [b]2v2 mode[/b], where you can join forces with a friend to lay siege to enemy towers and Nexi!

But that’s not all, we’ve also added: [b]New custom games[/b], [b]hotkey display[/b], [b]better cooldown display[/b], [b]better servers[/b], [b]feature unlocking[/b], and tons and tons of fixes, balancing and improvements. notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32216392/6dc7bf2e66b6c4af7b1dfd3a562f95933fd89c0a.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

only one week after the last update, we’re back at it again with another one, just like good ol’ times! This time, we’re adding 2v2 Custom Matches, as well as lots of secondary improvements and fixes that will take us one step closer to release.

[b]Custom 2v2 matches[/b] is something many players have asked for, and is now another (un)released feature. Just a reminder: You can access these (un)released features by clicking the big red “Unlock” button on the home screen. We’re also adding better [b]previews for player levels[/b], to give players a bit more long-term motivation and show them what the next level-ups will bring. The [b]Leaderboard [/b]have gotten an overhaul, with many more categories, like 2v2 and all the PvE challange modes. These Leaderboards are also now seasonal by month, so if you’ve missed out last month, you can always shoot for the top in the next.

We’ve been listening very intently to player feedback about the game’s [b]unlock progression[/b], and also about the pricing of cards. Based on that feedback and our own testing, we’ve decided to modify the unlock scaling, so progression is more regular and not such a grind. For [b]card pricing[/b], we are raising low level cards’ prices slightly, and lowering high level cards’ prices greatly, by a whopping 50%. 

To be fair to our veteran players, we’ll be giving anyone who previously bought high level cards the difference in price back as an instant bonus. We’ll also be deactivating Crystal tier ascension and queues for now, as those modes are going to stay reserved for post-release content. Again, to be fair, anyone who owns a Crystal card already will receive an additional Gold card of that type.

There are lots of other smaller fixes and improvements, as always you can find the full list below:

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added button to level up screen to see the level up overview
[*] Added 2v2 custom match mode
[*] Added button to level up screen to have a look at coming level up rewards
[*] Added monthly seasons and resets to the leaderboard
[*] Improved targeting of single target spells
[*] Extended Leaderboard to show 1vE, 2vE and 2v2 statistics
[*] Rebalanced metagame:
[*]  - Adjusted all unlock quests to new target values
[*]  - Stone cards cost increased from 400 Credits to 600 Credits
[*]  - Bronze cards cost increased from 800 Credits to 1200 Credits
[*]  - Gold cards cost reduced from 9600 Credits to 4800 Credits
[*]  - Legendary cards cost reduced from 14400 Credits to 7200 Credits
[*]  - Crystal tier pvp queue and ascension disabled
[*] Weekly quest is now automatically reset by the server and a countdown is shown
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Soul Maelstrom to now only target units as originally intended
[*] Fixed invite friend button in the game statistics screen, if your match partner is on the left side
[*] Fixed bug that you could create a deck during queuing
[*] Fixed bug that you don't receive any dialogs after a partner started a game while you were in a dialog
[*] Added stuck detection for loading screen, skipping it and writing further details into the error.log
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced range of “Missile Turret” from 24 to 14
[*] Missile turret now has ability “Predator: Air” dealing double damage to air units and monumental units (base buildings and very big units like Brratu)
[*] “Pulse of the Forest” now can replenish buildings energy, but does not stack anymore
[/list]

As always, you can keep up to date by following us on Twitter and Facebook:

notes.title: Rise of Legions - 2v2 is (un)released - Bring a friend!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32216392/6dc7bf2e66b6c4af7b1dfd3a562f95933fd89c0a.png[/img]

Heeeeelloooo everyone!

We’ve got some big news for you today! It’s reaaadyyy!! [b]2v2 is getting (un)released today!![/b] O_O

Why [b]“(un)released”[/b] you ask? Good question! We heard from many players that [u]they wanted 2v2 as soon as possible[/u], but we also really want to keep developing this mode with big changes, to make it the best it can possibly be. We think some players wouldn’t like a game mode getting such massive changes, and might get upset if we changed things around too much. So it looked like we could only either: 1) Delay the release, and upset some players, or 2) Throw it out there and keep working on it, which would upset some players. We couldn’t figure out a good way to go about it, until we came up with what we think is the best solution: 3) [u]Give players the choice![/u]

So we are now adding what we call [b]“Unreleased Features”[/b], which you can choose to unlock from the game’s main screen. These are experimental features that are still being heavily worked on, of which 2v2 is the first. These features will start out as fairly unbalanced, they might easily break, and they will keep evolving heavily in upcoming updates. If you don’t like these sorts of things, you can simply ignore the button and keep enjoying the game as before. But if you want to get your hands on these features early, and help us make them even better by giving your thoughts and feedback, you’re just a button click away :)

Another feature being added this update is the new [b]“Refer a friend”[/b] system. The idea is to let you easily introduce a friend to the game, and both you and the referred friend gain a nice bonus. The system is set up to be super simple, all you need is to send your friend your friend ID, which they can simply enter on the “Redeem Bonus Code” menu in the shop. This will grant you both some bonus crystals, and your referred friend will also get some premium time and a deck slot to get them going. There is only one requirement, which is that your friend must be [u]level 5[/u] to redeem the referral bonus. Also, to be fair to our veteran players, we have made getting referred available to all legacy accounts as well, so [u]all older accounts will also be able to get referred once[/u].

We’ve also added spawners now creating newly spawned units at the same position they are at, so you can strategically plan your positioning right from the start. Here’s the (short) changelist:

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added refer a friend system
[*]Made spawners use grid position for positioning when spawning new units
[*]Added an option to unlock unreleased & experimental features before release
[*]Added 2v2 in experimental mode, need to unlock experimental features to access
[*]Added more languages to CrowdIn
[/list]

We’re super excited to be getting 2v2 out there so early already, and we’re really looking forward to your feedback on it! Our goal is to keep iterating on it until it’s the very best it can be, so please share your ideas and let us know your thoughts!

As always, you can keep up to date by following us on Twitter and Facebook:

https://twitter.com/Rise_Of_Legions

We’re always curious to hear what you think! Join us on the Discord to share your opinion, chat or just hangout!

notes.title: Rise of Legions - Co-op, Fullscreen Meta-Client and lots of Fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32216392/6dc7bf2e66b6c4af7b1dfd3a562f95933fd89c0a.png[/img]

Hey guys!

How is everybody? After a short pause in updates, we're back and kicking! This time around, we have an update focusing on lots of technical fixes and improvements, but also giving [b]Co-op[/b] a better spotlight.

To start things off, as per usual, we've got some [b]balancing changes[/b]. The Monk got some love, and Avengers and the Lich got tuned down a bit. Also, Skelly archers got a little nerf. The tower and Mana changes from the last major patch seem to have gone over very well, with us seeing mostly positive feedback from players. As always, we're still open and thankful for feedback on all of this, so please keep it coming!

[b]Co-op[/b] is starting to get the attention it deserves this update, starting with an own dedicated tab in the Play menu. Lots of players actually didn't know we even had a Co-op mode, so we hope this will let a lot more people enjoy it. We've rebalanced Co-op and Golem Challenges in general to offer some more interesting gameplay. This will also allow our veteran players to come up with some new and improved strategies to master them. Same as with balancing, we are very interested in your feedback on these changes!

Besides those headliners, we've put a lot of work into some necessary [b]compatibility improvements[/b], like adding more screen sizes in the meta-client. The screen is now resizable from the options menu, which will help players with smaller screens as well as streamers and Youtubers. And as a bonus on top, you can now also switch the meta-client to fullscreen mode!

To round things off, we fixed stuff like the disconnect issue that players were having after one player's connection dropped, deck tiers not showing up correctly and some smaller bugs with certain units. There's also better error reporting, which will definitely pay dividends in the future.

notes.title: Rise of Legions - Lots of Balancing and Heating up the Action!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32216392/6dc7bf2e66b6c4af7b1dfd3a562f95933fd89c0a.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

we skipped last week, so this week’s patch is extra big and extra juicy, with lots of [b]gameplay improvements[/b]! The focus was to make games more dynamic and action-packed, and stop certain tactics that could make the game boring, both for the winning and the losing player. We also did some unit and spell re-balancing, with the same goals in mind, which should make games a lot more fun and enjoyable. We also added two new skins plus two more that will be available as rewards soon!

Part of the goal this week was to make fighting between towers less static. By reducing the tower reload speeds, players can now continue an attack on a tower over multiple waves instead of always being faced with a fully reloaded tower each time they approach. Another goal was to shorten drawn out games, so we’ve reduced the Nexus ammo across the board. Your Nexus can still hold off one pretty big push, but it won’t draw out the game forever.

The effects of [b]Summoning Sickness[/b] have been greatly reduced. The duration is shorter and units no longer take double damage while being summoned. This allows a lot of interesting tactics, like summoning units directly on the battlefield, that weren’t really possible before. Summoned units are still vulnerable though, as they won’t be able to defend themselves during summoning.

Another goal for this patch was to stop certain semi-exploit strategies that relied on getting [b]double spawns[/b] and/or saving up lots of Mana while simply not doing anything. To get this done, we’ve both reduced the Mana caps and increased the income rates. After these changes we saw much more action-packed games, while still not changing the general game feel too much. To address the double spawn strats, we’ve changed the mechanics of the spawners to now only immediately spawn a unit if the spawning field is active, and then not spawn another until the next spawning cycle.

Especially at lower levels, there could often be situations of big blobs of high damage/low health units forming, that were impossible to counter, which could be extremely frustrating. To balance this, we’ve given one low-tier spell of each Legion a moderate damage effect, which can be used to break up these “DPS blobs” and should allow players to get back into the game in these situations.

On top of that, we also did a bunch of [b]unit balance[/b] changes, which are mainly based on community feedback. So thanks to all of you who contributed feedback and ideas! In that vein, a few of you might also have noticed a certain flying unit getting a new ability... Hats off to all you “[b]Wisp Defenders[/b]” out there, you made it happen! :)

Whew, that was a lot of text! So without further ado, here’s the full changelist:

[h1]Balancing[/h1]

[b]Base Buildings[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced “Nexus” Ammo to 31 across all tiers 
[*] “Nexus” is now spell immune
[*] “Lane Tower” reload speed reduced by 50%
[*] “Lane Tower” and “Nexus”: Main target of projectile now only gets single target damage, not splash damage as well
[/list]

[b]White[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased “Heavy Gunner” Lightgrenades Splash-radius from 2.5 to 3.0
[*] Reduced “Archer” damage from 21 to 20
[*] Increased “Archer” health from 23 to 25
[*] Increased “Monk” health from 205 to 225
[*] “Light Pulse” now also deals 15 damage
[*] Increased “Light Pulse” cost from 80 to 130 Mana
[/list]

[b]Black[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced “Shatter Ice” damage from 1000 to 200
[*] Increased “Soul Cauldron” health from 155 to 190
[*] Increased “Vecra” health from 345 to 375
[*] “Frost Shock” now freezes units as well as buildings and fires 12 shards at nearby targets
[*] Increased “Frost Shock” cost from 80 to 130 Mana
[/list]

[b]Green[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased “Rootling” health from 190 to 200
[*] Increased “Rooted” effect damage from 1 to 2 each second
[*] Increased “Entangling Roots” cost from 80 to 130 Mana
[*] Reduced “Woodwalker” health from 170 to 115
[*] Reduced “Rootdood” Mana cost for "Dood Root" from 2 to 1
[*] Increased “Rootdood” range of "Dood Root" from 8 to 11
[*] “Wisp” has a new ability: Depleting Bounce (Attacks bounce and hit up to 6 random targets; each hit reduces the damage of the next bounce by the damage dealt)
[/list]

[b]Blue[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced “Gatling Turret” health from 250 to 210
[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced Summoning Sickness from 2.5 to 1 second. Units also don’t receive double damage anymore while being summoned
[*] Reduced Mana Caps (Stage 1: 400 / Stage 2: 500 / Stage 3: 600)
[*] Mana gain increased to +2 instead of +1 with every income upgrade
[*] Stage times Stone are now: Stage 2 starts at 3 min, Showdown starts at 6 min
[*] Stage times Bronze/Silver are now: Stage 2 starts at 3 min, Stage 3 at 6 min, Showdown at 9 min
[*] Stage times Gold+ are now: Stage 2 starts at 4 min, Stage 3 at 8 min, Showdown at 12 min
[*] Spawn Tiles now glow when they are ready for instant spawning. If a Spawner is placed on a glowing tile, it spawns instantly. If the tile is not glowing, the unit doesn’t spawn until the next spawning cycle
[/list]

[h1]Skins[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Cultist (Monk Skin)
[*] Added Predictor (Oracle Skin)
[*] Added WIP Priest (Limited Reward)
[*] Added Rainbow Skeleton Archers (Quest Reward)
[/list]

While this round of balancing was very important for the current state of the game and also for future features (we always have [b]2v2[/b] in mind), we can understand that many of you would like to know more about our near-term plans. We're planning on releasing more information on the game's roadmap soon, so the community knows how things are shaping up on our way to full release. Keep your eyes peeled on our social media and Discord to hear more about that soon!

You can keep up to date by following us on Twitter and Facebook:

https://twitter.com/Rise_Of_Legions
https://www.facebook.com/RiseOfLegions

As always, we’re curious to hear what you think! Join us on the Discord to share your opinion, chat or just hangout!

notes.title: Closed Beta Stage 3
notes.content:
As the spooky season comes to a close, we got some good news to cheer you up!

First and foremost, the next closed beta will start Friday, November 2nd at 8pm, CEST and will last until Monday, November 5th at 11:59 pm CEST.

The first version of the guided tutorial is finished, the ascension and leveling mechanics have been reworked and the PvP gameplay has been adjusted to make early stomps less likely. In addition to that, here’s a list of what we’ve been working on:

- New Interface animations (popups, level-ups, etc.)
- Balancing adjustments (Units,Spells).
- General gameplay adjustments (The towers are a bit stronger which leads to less early game stomps and makes siege units more valuable).
- Navigation bar/game mode selection rework (better usability).
- Unlock deck slots feature.
- All starter decks are unlocked after the tutorial. Starter decks are then added as presets to your decklist..
- Plus a lot of minor quality of life improvements (custom hotkeys, etc.)

In the spirit of focusing on what matters most from now to early access release, and because we are such a small team, we have decided to remove the 2v2 game mode for now. We will bring it back later. This allows us to concentrate all our efforts and time on bringing you the best 1v1 experience we can give you for the early access release.

Check out our new trailer as well! <3 

See you guys ingame!

notes.title: Update on our next steps!
notes.content:
The closed beta will come to an end today at 5pm CEST. It has been a blast for us so far! We received a lot of valuable feedback and insights from the community, which we will use to make Rise of Legions even better! Thank you so much to everyone that participated!
We will be hosting another week-long closed beta around the beginning of October. We will also announce the Early Access Release Date pretty... erm, soon xD (soon, actually).


Here's an update on our next steps:

From now to early access:
- There will be a guided tutorial! Yes, finally.
- The starter deck decision in the beginning of the game will be removed. Instead, all starter deck cards are going to be unlocked. The tutorial will be played with the White Legion.
- There will be default decks for new players (created from the starter-deck card pool). These will allow to instantly get into the action, without the necessity to build a deck.
- The ascension system will be reworked. We already have a good idea on how we want to change this but we don't want to spoil too much in case it doesn't work out and we decide to go into a different direction.
- We are working on an experimental feature for the core game experience. It might not make it into the release version so we don't really want to talk about it too much but... If all goes well, expect a positive and explosive impact on the gameplay experience! This is the one change that is getting us the most excited internally so we really hope it passes implementation and also the next few tests we have for it and then we will let you guys know all about it (:
- There might be a premium account for the early access version that provides an xp- and currency-boost over a set timespan.
- We want to add 5 levels to every PvE difficulty. There will also be a progression through these levels so you can't just choose any difficulty from the beginning, you have to unlock them. (The highest difficulty will have some visual adjustments as well)
- We are always adjusting balance, progression and rewards along the way based on all the great feedback we receive, and also from the secret data that our voodoo hamsters are gathering directly from the database!
- We will of course finalize the special closed beta Rewards. 
- Most profiles and deck icons will be locked in the beginning. You will be able to unlock some of them throughout the new and revamped progression.
- The way spawners spawn units will visually be adjusted to make it more intuitive. 
- There is quite a long list of quality-of-life improvements and things to polish in general. All of this needs to happen, but we need to focus on the core systems first before we start on that sweet polish.
As most of you might know by now we are a very small team and only have a limited amount of time. Because of that some of our plans are always subject to change. We're always doing our best to deliver though! (:

Last but not least, a BIG thanks goes out to all of you who participated in the betas so far! It's super exciting for us to see how you guys experience the game. We are more than happy to have you :heart:

More to come about our plans for early access during and after the next closed beta. Stay tuned!
